description:
If you love Almond Joy candy bars, you’re going to LOVE this homemade Almond Joy ice cream! This rich and creamy coconut-based ice cream is packed with toasted almonds, sweet coconut flakes, and chunks of dark chocolate—just like the classic candy bar.

🔔 Don’t forget to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE for more amazing ice cream recipes!

⏰ Timestamps:
0:00 - Intro
0:48 - Ingredients breakdown
2:44 - Making the coconut ice cream base
6:10 - Churning, adding coconut and chocolate 
7:57 - Dish up the churned version
9:45 - Ninja Creami Version
12:55 - Almond Joy vs Bounty Bar
13:22 - Outro

📌 Tags & Keywords:
#AlmondJoy #IceCreamRecipe #HomemadeIceCream #NoChurnIceCream #CoconutIceCream #AlmondJoyDessert #ChocolateLovers #EasyDessert #FoodScience #FrozenTreats

Enjoy and let me know in the comments—what’s your favorite candy bar-inspired ice cream? 🍫🥥✨
